scope: Adopt the borrowed cache-entry fix for cached cubic, all three RGB targets and both precisions

environment.rustc:
rustc 1.98.1 (48a229cea 2026-09-01)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: 48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985
commit-date: 2026-09-01
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.98.1
LLVM version: 22.1.8

change.implementation: OklchCubic::hue_data returns &HueData; fills zero-marker buckets in place before borrowing the stored entry
change.preserved: Native scalar types, 3601 x 13-scalar cache, 0.1-degree buckets, all root/conversion/encoding arithmetic and mode policy
change.reason: Eliminate intermediate full-record copy on cache hits, removing native f64 stack-alignment sensitivity; no harness padding or compiler-flag workaround

rust.behavior: Returns HueData by value; copying pattern predates the refactor

javascript.behavior: cachedHueData returns a bucket offset into a flat Float64Array; caller reads cached coefficients directly

compatibility.manifest: Same 136960-input manifest as the milestone-three P3 compatibility comparison, applied to each gamut

assembly.finding: P3 f64 checked closure loads t_lower from the cache, then skips the cold-fill branch to load coefficients directly from the cached entry; full-record stack copy removed from the hit path

benchmark.process_order: Each mode: P3/sRGB/Rec.2020, before then after per target; then Rec.2020/sRGB/P3, after then before per target. Checked mode then plain mode.

workload_manifest.random: Independent stratified/jittered then shuffled H/L, C=0.4
workload_manifest.precision: f64 originals, f32 rounded before timing

benchmark.checksum: All three channels widened/accumulated per sample, consumed with black_box before timer stops. Construction, cache warmup, mode/gamut dispatch outside timing.
benchmark.scope: Full, output-consuming harness; no concurrent builds/tests/benchmarks. Same flags on both binaries. P3 uses default target arguments; other targets use --gamut. Medians of two process medians.

followup.reason: Check the largest initial increases in unchanged f32 kernels
followup.note: All three checked timing closures have identical normalized instructions, constants and branch structure; addresses differ. The full-harness differences are recorded, not attributed to added algorithm work.

limitations: Timing is native Ryzen 9800X3D only; portable x86-64 correctness, not performance, was tested.
Two process medians establish large changes more reliably than small fluctuations. Code placement can still affect unrelated methods.
Output equivalence is sampled, not a full-domain proof.
